holm_family: all pairs of non-mock adapters; mock pairs reported unadjusted

presidio.config: AnalyzerEngine() defaults, language=en, no entity filter, score_threshold=0.0; AnonymizerEngine() default replace-with-<ENTITY>

presidio-all-t0.4.config: AnalyzerEngine() defaults, language=en, no entity filter, score_threshold=0.4; AnonymizerEngine() default replace-with-<ENTITY>

presidio-nemo6-t0.config: AnalyzerEngine() defaults, language=en, entities=PERSON,EMAIL_ADDRESS,PHONE_NUMBER,CREDIT_CARD,US_SSN,LOCATION, score_threshold=0.0; AnonymizerEngine() default replace-with-<ENTITY>

presidio-nemo6-t0.4.config: AnalyzerEngine() defaults, language=en, entities=PERSON,EMAIL_ADDRESS,PHONE_NUMBER,CREDIT_CARD,US_SSN,LOCATION, score_threshold=0.4; AnonymizerEngine() default replace-with-<ENTITY>

nemo-guardrails.config: mask_sensitive_data action (Presidio-backed, local, no LLM); 6 entities; effective threshold 0.4 (fixed by NeMo's mask action); GLiNER NIM rails not used

nemo-guardrails-all.config: mask_sensitive_data action (Presidio-backed, local, no LLM); 20 entities; effective threshold 0.4 (fixed by NeMo's mask action); GLiNER NIM rails not used

nemo-guardrails-detect.config: detect_sensitive_data (blocking) action (Presidio-backed, local, no LLM); 6 entities; effective threshold 0.4; GLiNER NIM rails not used

piiguard.config: Guard.from_dir(guard/), learned rules only; no classifier, no LLM
piiguard.disclosure: piiguard is written by the benchmark author (reference row).

piiguard-pgpresidio.config: Guard.from_dir(guard/), learned rules + piiguard PresidioDetector (its defaults: score_threshold=0.5, 15 default entities); no LLM classifier
piiguard-pgpresidio.disclosure: piiguard is written by the benchmark author (reference row).

piiguard-union-presidio.config: Union of Guard.from_dir(guard/) learned rules and presidio AnalyzerEngine() defaults (all recognizers, threshold 0) on the original text; merged spans replaced with <PII>
piiguard-union-presidio.disclosure: piiguard is written by the benchmark author (reference row).

gliner-pii.config: GLiNER urchade/gliner_multi_pii-v1, 12 labels (one per benchmark category, fixed a priori), threshold 0.5, 256-token chunks (32 overlap), replace with <LABEL>

llm-guard-anonymize.config: llm_guard.input_scanners.Anonymize(Vault()) library defaults; sanitized text, never blocks

llm-guard-block.config: llm_guard.input_scanners.Anonymize(Vault()) library defaults; blocked when the scanner returns is_valid=False
